title: MAI-Transcribe-1 Speech Recognition Model by Microsoft
summary: MAI-Transcribe-1 is a proprietary automatic speech recognition model from Microsoft AI designed for high-accuracy batch and real-time transcription. It achieves a world-leading 3.88% Word Error Rate on the FLEURS benchmark and is optimized for noisy environments.
research_notes: Outperforms OpenAI's Whisper Large v3 and Google's Gemini 1.5 Flash in speed and accuracy; priced competitively at $0.36 per hour of audio.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 as part of Microsoft's first-party foundation model stack, it is currently in Public Preview via Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI Foundry. It is being integrated into Microsoft Teams and Copilot's Voice mode.
